serie: Loretta's Church Kitchen (The Church Supper Way): an 81-year-old Iowa church lady cooks one recipe from her little cookbook, the church supper and potluck dishes of the basement kitchen, and tells the story behind the trick
acciones: stirring a pot, sliding a 9x13 pan into the oven, lifting a lid, tasting from a wooden spoon, carrying a covered dish, setting a church supper table, peeling an egg under cold water, spooning filling into halved eggs
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s farmhouse kitchen in Iowa: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a rooster cookie jar on a dark wooden dresser, a worn wooden table, a wall calendar
lugares_fijos.sotano: the church basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist in Story County, Iowa: long folding tables with white paper covers, a big steel stove and steam table, a pass-through window, stacks of plain white plates, a wall clock
lugares_fijos.comedor: the church basement dining hall at a potluck: long folding tables with paper tablecloths, rows of covered casserole dishes, a cold table with deviled eggs on a glass platter, paper plates, coffee urns on a side table

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
